scenario_splits.note: Train/validation/test seed ranges are disjoint integer ranges in Phase 3A's own namespace (520000-522999), never overlapping Phase 1's default seed (0) or Phase 2A/2B's controlled-scenario namespace (410000-414999). Every scenario is built by the frozen Phase 1 generate_scenario function -- never a Phase-3A-local reimplementation -- so every guarantee generate_scenario already makes (>=1 usable provider when the pool is non-empty, etc.) applies identically to every split.

metadata.note: This script does not itself re-run `pytest tests/`; docs/phase3b_review.md records the full-suite result for this run. Phase 3A's own persisted results/phase3a/qlearning_summary.json is READ, never recomputed or overwritten.

hyperparameter_selection.selection_criterion: maximize A*-optimal episode percentage subject to success_rate tied for the maximum observed on the validation split; ties broken by lower mean cost gap, then higher mean return.

distribution_shift_summary.label: distribution_shift -- NOT part of the frozen Phase 3A train/validation/test split

offline_computational_cost.note: Offline (training) cost is measured independently of A*'s online planning cost and Q-learning's offline training cost; Phase 3B §22/§23 explicitly forbid comparing offline training cost to A*'s online runtime as if they were the same computational phase.

online_computational_cost.note: Repeated-measurement microbenchmark (n_repeats=2000) on a single fixed (observation, action_mask) pair -- a single neural-network inference call is near timing-noise scale, per Phase 3B §23.
